definitions.explanation: Producing a desired or intended result; having an effect.

examples.japanese: {効果的|こうかてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{効果的|こうかてき}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This medicine is effective against colds.

examples.japanese: {効果的|こうかてき}な⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}しています→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for an effective study method.

notes:
{効果的|こうかてき} is a na-adjective meaning effective or productive.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {効果的|こうかてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (effectively)
- Noun stem: ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (effect, result)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{効果的|こうかてき}: effective for/against ~
- {効果的|こうかてき}な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: effective method
- {効果的|こうかてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use effectively

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧: valid, effective (often for tickets, contracts)
- ⟦{効率的|こうりつてき}→効率的：06240_kouritsuteki⟧: efficient (focus on minimal waste)

Common in business, medical, and educational contexts.
